title: A look-alike rename on the Part Library page names the location it clashes with
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two parts for this test at the test location, part A and part B, with a hyphen in part B's part number.
  • Use a number to type, number 1: part B's number in lower case with spaces in place of its hyphens, which no Part Library entry has exactly.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  4. Replace the Part Number with number 1.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Wait 5 seconds.
  7. Click Cancel.
  8. Click Parts in the top bar.
  9. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  10. Type part B's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry is listed.

Step 2:

  • The entry's detail page opens.

Step 3:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens, holding part A's part number.

Step 4:

  • Part Number shows number 1.

Step 5:

  • The save is refused and the window stays open.
  • A red message reads part B's part number, written as it was saved, followed by "already exists at" and the test location's name, then a full stop, with a smaller second line "Please try to resolve this."
  • The message gives the location's name, not the words "this location": the Part Library page has no current location.

Step 6:

  • The red message has gone on its own after about 3 seconds, and the window is still open.

Step 7:

  • The window closes and the entry still shows part A's own number.

Step 8:

  • The Parts left menu shows Part Library.

Step 9:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 10:

  • Part B's entry is listed with its own number, unchanged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 35 (edited 27 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog), story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only)

  • S13-N1a: “The save is also refused when another part, at any other location that stocks this part, has a number that matches the typed one, ignoring upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces. The dialog stays open, and the system shows "{existing part number} already exists at {location}." A match at the part's own location is refused with S7-N3 or S7-N4 instead. On the Part Library detail page, which has no current location, S13-N1a applies at every location.”
  • S11-R3a: “Changing an entry's number or description on its detail page follows the part dialog's rules: S13-R12 to S13-R19, S13-N1, S13-N7, and S10-R23 to S10-R25.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Renamed number matches a part at another location that stocks it | "{existing part number} already exists at {location}." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds; the dialog stays open”
  • Story 13, context note: “Context note: every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this." Messages the screen builds itself carry their own second line, as listed, or none.”

From: Product's answers to questions 13 to 27 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pkAPGqWVTdtYorNN4SVNl9HkHxuuB9czro_y2DbUeEM/edit, saved word for word in full-pass-2026-10-27/ANSWERS-13-27-2026-10-27.md), read 28 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, answer 23: “"AB-100 already exists at this location." (S7-N3), or the inactive version (S7-N4) if the AB-100 here is inactive. The "{location}" wording shows only for a clash at another location that stocks the part, or for a rename made on the Part Library page (S13-N1a).”
